questions.question: When the women came to Jesus' tomb, what did the angel tell them about Him?

answers.text: He has risen just as He said
He was moved to another tomb
He has gone to the temple courts

questions.question: After rising from the dead, Jesus met His eleven disciples on a mountain. What did He say had been given to Him?

answers.text: All authority in heaven and on earth
A throne in the city of Jerusalem
Rest from all His work on earth

questions.question: After rising from the dead, Jesus told His eleven disciples to make disciples of whom?
When Jesus sent out His eleven disciples, how long did He promise to be with them?

answers.text: Always to the end of the age
Until they reach every last nation
Until their work in Galilee is done
